name: Garden Co.,Ltd.
summary: Garden Co., Ltd. is engaged in the food and beverage business. It operates ramen, steak and sushi restaurants as well as franchise and real estate businesses related to its brands, which include Yokohama Iekei Ramen Ikkakuya. The company was founded by Ken Kawashima on December 1, 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
